questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence with reported speech.
He said, 'I am going to the cinema.'
options: He said he is going to the cinema.
He said he was going to the cinema.
He said he goes to the cinema.
He said he had been going to the cinema.
questions.answer: He said he was going to the cinema.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb in reported speech.
She said that she ________ tired after the long journey.
options: was
were
had been
would be

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the following statement?
'I won't tell anyone about it.'
options: He said he won't tell anyone about it.
He said he wouldn't tell anyone about it.
He said he didn't tell anyone about it.
He said he wasn't telling anyone about it.
questions.answer: He said he wouldn't tell anyone about it.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported form.
He asked me, 'What time does the train depart?'

He asked me what time the train departed.
options: He asked me what time the train departed.
He asked me what time did the train depart.
He asked me what time does the train depart.
He asked me what time do the train depart.
questions.answer: He asked me what time the train departed.

questions.question:
Which option correctly reports the question?
She asked me if I had finished my homework.
options: She asked me if I had finished my homework.
She asked me whether I had finished my homework.
She asked me if I have finished my homework.
She asked me whether I have finished my homework.
questions.answer: She asked me whether I had finished my homework.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported speech form.
He said, 'I have just eaten lunch.'
options: He said he has just eaten lunch.
He said he had just eaten lunch.
He said he was just eating lunch.
He said he is just eating lunch.
questions.answer: He said he had just eaten lunch.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported form of the sentence.
'I must admit that I was wrong.'
options: He admitted he was wrong.
He admitted he were wrong.
He admitted he was wrong.
He admitted he has been wrong.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the statement?
'I wish I had studied harder for the exam.'
options: He wished he had studied harder for the exam.
He wished he studies harder for the exam.
He wished he had studied harder for the exam.
He wished he would study harder for the exam.
questions.answer: He wished he had studied harder for the exam.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported form.
He said to me, 'Don't forget to call me tomorrow.'
options: He told me not to forget to call him tomorrow.
He told me to not forget to call him tomorrow.
He told me not to forget calling him tomorrow.
He told me to not forget calling him tomorrow.
questions.answer: He told me not to forget to call him tomorrow.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported form of the question.
'Do you know where the library is?' she asked me.
options: She asked me if I knew where the library was.
She asked me whether I knew where the library was.
She asked me if I know where the library is.
She asked me whether I know where the library is.
questions.answer: She asked me if I knew where the library was.
